content:
We have a new stable release of Lean v4.29.0.

Please see the release notes for v4.29.0 for full details.

As usual Mathlib, doc-gen4, verso, Batteries, Aesop, Cslib, and the REPL are available using these toolchains via the v4.29.0 tag at the respective repositories (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.95).

We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.29.0 when possible (and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating). (Recall that you can use the lean-update github action to help automate this process.)

v4.29.0 brings some significant breaking changes to the language, addressing long-standing problems with handling of transparency settings. These changes have reveal widespread problems in libraries with "leaking definitions", and the adaptation process to v4.29.0 is more complicated than usual.

I will post below a description of these changes, and a short migration guide. But please be warned: considerable thought and expertise is still required to complete the migration successfully in Mathlib, and downstream projects may encounter difficulties. Please ask questions on the Zulip if you are encountering difficulties!
Description of changes and migration guide are now posted in the #general > Discussion thread for release of `v4.29.0`
v4.29.1 has been released, with a fix for lean4#13388.
